text:
maria: Heads-up — the 'Dedicated capacity' runbook has a broken reference under 'autoscaling policies'. Saw a 404 from staging while testing the canary. Anyone able to take a quick look?
link-checker: link-checker automated scan -> 404 detected: /docs/infra/autoscale (found in /runbooks/dedicated-capacity.md) | severity: low | report: https://ci.internal/link-scan/DT-1234
alex: I can take a look today. Which exact file and broken URL?
maria: The runbook is /runbooks/dedicated-capacity.md. It links to /docs/infra/autoscale which 404s. I uploaded the screenshot to the ticket: https://tickets.internal/DT-1234
jin: I started a quick branch: git checkout -b fix/runbook-autoscale. I'll replace the bad link with the correct target or add a redirect. Tagging @alex @sam for review.
sam: :wave: will review after lunch, thanks for grabbing it Jin.
alex: Quick Q — does /docs/dedicated/autoscaling exist in main? I only see /docs/infra/autoscaling-v2.md. If the canonical page moved we should point to that or add a 301 redirect so runbooks don't break.
maria: Good catch. Ops prefers redirects for short-lived renames, but pointing to the canonical infra page is simpler. Which do you folks prefer?
docs-bot: Note: if you add a redirect please include a short entry in docs-redirects.yml so the redirect scan picks it up.
jin: I'll update the branch to point at /docs/infra/autoscaling-v2.md and add an anchor for the runbook link. Also added a tiny clarifying sentence about expected policy fields. Example snippet in the patch: ```bash
curl -sS https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/autoscaling-v2 | grep policy
```
sam: :thumbsup: looks good. Alex, can you LGTM the small wording change when you have a minute?
alex: LGTM with one nit — change "autoscale policy" -> "autoscaling policy" in the top paragraph, and please add a stable anchor like #autoscaling-policies so runbooks don't break if filenames move.
maria: Thanks — @jin can you add the anchor `#autoscaling-policies` and push? If someone prefers a redirect I can file the ops ticket after merge.
jin: Done, pushed the update and anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — includes link fix + anchor + one-line clarifying note.
link-checker: link-checker re-scan -> no 404s found for /runbooks/dedicated-capacity.md. All good.
maria: :tada: great, leaving this thread open until PR merges and deploy goes out.
sam: Can someone add a one-line changelog entry (doc fixes) so product knows this touched runbooks?
alex: I'll add a tiny note in the merge commit.
maria: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
